# Andy Whyte Journal (AWJ)

> A notebook of principles for sales, founding and being human. Twenty handwritten Maxims, one line each, with the essay behind every one, from Andy Whyte, founder and CEO of MEDDICC and author of the best-selling book on sales qualification.

Andy Whyte is the founder and CEO of [MEDDICC](https://meddicc.com/) and the author of *MEDDICC: The ultimate guide to staying one step ahead in the complex sale* (over 100,000 copies sold, 4.7 stars across 1,447+ Amazon reviews; more than 35,000 graduates of the MEDDICC Masterclass). He spent twenty years in sales at companies including Oracle, Sprinklr, Tealium, Branch and Poq before founding MEDDICC in 2021. He keynotes at sales kickoffs and revenue summits for organisations including CrowdStrike, Microsoft, Amazon Web Services and Dun and Bradstreet.

He writes and speaks about four subjects, each with its own hub: MEDDPICC and MEDDICC, sales leadership, keynote speaking, and imposter syndrome.

## Start

- [Start here](https://andywhyte.com/start-here/): who Andy is, how to read the notebook, where to begin by role
- [The Maxims](https://andywhyte.com/maxims/): every Maxim in order, with the photographed page and the essay
- [The notebook](https://andywhyte.com/): the home page, where the pages turn

## Topic hubs

- [MEDDPICC and MEDDICC](https://andywhyte.com/meddpicc/): the qualification framework, letter by letter, from the person who wrote the book on it
- [Sales leadership](https://andywhyte.com/sales-leadership/): deal inspection, forecasts, deal reviews, A, B and C players, judging decisions not outcomes
- [Keynote speaking](https://andywhyte.com/keynote-speaking/): what Andy speaks about and what a sales kickoff keynote should do
- [Imposter syndrome](https://andywhyte.com/imposter-syndrome/): only the self-aware suffer from it, and why that is a strength

## Reference

- [Glossary](https://andywhyte.com/glossary/): Metrics, Economic Buyer, Decision Criteria, Decision Process, Paper Process, Implicate the Pain, Champion, Competition, and the vocabulary of qualification and sales leadership, each defined in one sentence and explained on its own page
- [Frameworks](https://andywhyte.com/frameworks/): MEDDPICC, the Champion Test, qualifying out, deal inspection, A, B and C players, judge decisions not outcomes, leading indicators

## Pillars

- [Sales](https://andywhyte.com/pillars/sales/): MEDDICC, deal inspection and sales as a thinking discipline
- [Founder](https://andywhyte.com/pillars/founder/): bootstrapped SaaS, trade-offs under uncertainty, no theatre
- [Human](https://andywhyte.com/pillars/human/): authenticity, imposter syndrome, mental health and growth
